JOIN kpi k ON k.id = ek.kpi_id LEFT JOIN kpi pk ON pk.id = k.parent_id JOIN perspective pe ON pe.id = k.perspective_id JOIN unit_of_measure uom ON uom.id = k.unit_of_measure_id JOIN org_unit au ON au.id = k.assigning_unit_id JOIN org_unit eu ON eu.id = k.evaluating_unit_id JOIN scoring_method sm ON sm.id = k.scoring_method_id

ORDER BY ${q.orderBy} LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

mapper.sql: r.id, r.evaluation_kpi_id, ek.kpi_id, k.code AS kpi_code, k.name AS kpi_name, k.parent_id AS parent_kpi_id, pe.name AS perspective_name, pe.color AS perspective_color, uom.name AS unit_of_measure_name, ek.year, ek.period_code, ek.status AS eval_kpi_status, r.org_unit_id, o.code AS org_unit_code, o.name AS org_unit_name, o.unit_type, r.assignment_detail_id, d.weight, r.plan_value, r.year_plan_value, r.kpi_result, r.prev_adjustment, r.adjustment, r.final_result, r.completion_rate, r.year_completion_rate, r.score, r.manual_score, r.bsc_score, r.rating, r.status, r.description, r.calc_error, r.result_before_adjust, r.result_after_adjust, r.updated_at, r.version

SELECT DISTINCT pr.id FROM evaluation_result cr JOIN evaluation_kpi cek ON cek.id = cr.evaluation_kpi_id JOIN kpi ck ON ck.id = cek.kpi_id JOIN evaluation_kpi pek ON pek.kpi_id = ck.parent_id AND pek.year = cek.year AND pek.period_code = cek.period_code JOIN evaluation_result pr ON pr.evaluation_kpi_id = pek.id AND pr.org_unit_id = cr.org_unit_id AND pr.deleted = 0 WHERE cr.id IN #{i}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.weight), 0) FROM kpi_assignment_detail d JOIN kpi k ON k.id = d.kpi_id WHERE d.org_unit_id = #{orgUnitId} AND d.year = #{year} AND d.deleted = 0 AND k.parent_id IS NULL AND d.status <> 'DANG_SOAN'
SELECT DISTINCT parent_id FROM kpi WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 0

SELECT r.score, d.weight FROM evaluation_result r JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id JOIN kpi k ON k.id = ek.kpi_id LEFT JOIN kpi_assignment_detail d ON d.id = r.assignment_detail_id WHERE k.parent_id = #{parentKpiId} AND ek.year = #{year} AND ek.period_code = #{period} AND r.org_unit_id = #{orgUnitId} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT v.id, v.result_id, v.component_id, c.code, c.name, c.source, c.formula_definition_id, f.code AS formula_code, v.value, v.unit_proposed_value, v.prev_adjustment, v.unit_proposed_adjustment, v.adjustment, v.final_value, v.note, v.synced_at FROM evaluation_component_value v JOIN kpi_component c ON c.id = v.component_id LEFT JOIN formula_definition f ON f.id = c.formula_definition_id WHERE v.result_id IN #{i} ORDER BY v.result_id, c.sort_order, c.id

SELECT c.id AS component_id, c.code, c.name, c.source, c.formula_definition_id, f.code AS formula_code FROM kpi_component c LEFT JOIN formula_definition f ON f.id = c.formula_definition_id WHERE c.kpi_id = #{kpiId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_component_value (result_id, component_id, source, value, synced_at, note, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{componentId}, #{source}, #{value}, IF(#{synced}, NOW(3), NULL), #{note}, 'system', 'system') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value), synced_at = IF(#{synced}, NOW(3), synced_at), note = COALESCE(VALUES(note), note), updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_component_value SET prev_adjustment = #{prevAdjustment}, final_value = #{finalValue} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ek.period_code AS period, v.adjustment FROM evaluation_component_value v JOIN evaluation_result r ON r.id = v.result_id JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id WHERE v.component_id = #{componentId} AND r.org_unit_id = #{orgUnitId} AND ek.year = #{year} AND r.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adjustment_request (result_id, proposal_note, status, requested_by_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{proposalNote}, 'CHO_XU_LY', #{requestedById}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.sql: a.id, a.result_id, a.proposal_note, a.status, a.requested_by_id, u.full_name AS requested_by_name, a.created_by, a.created_at, a.handled_by, a.handled_at, a.handling_reason, a.decision_file_id, f.original_name AS decision_file_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM adjustment_request a LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = a.requested_by_id LEFT JOIN file_object f ON f.id = a.decision_file_id WHERE a.result_id = #{resultId} AND a.status = 'CHO_XU_LY' AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM adjustment_request a LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = a.requested_by_id LEFT JOIN file_object f ON f.id = a.decision_file_id WHERE a.result_id = #{resultId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE adjustment_request SET status = 'DA_XU_LY', handled_by = #{by}, handled_by_id = #{byId}, handled_at = NOW(3), handling_reason = #{reason}, decision_file_id = #{fileId}, updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, original_name, size FROM file_object WHERE owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
